text: On the authority of Jaber bin Abdullah - may God be pleased with him - he said: I heard the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, say: If a man enters his house and mentions God - the Almighty - when he enters, and when he eats, Satan says: You have no place to stay or have dinner. And if he enters and does not mention God when he enters, Satan will say: You have spent the night spending the night, and if he does not mention God when eating, he will say: You have spent the night and dinner.
